Maskwire - A toolbox for your existing email

# A toolbox for the email you already use. 

 Maskwire is an IMAP/SMTP proxy between your mail app and your provider. Enable tools for alias replies, sender rewriting, text redaction, and more. 

One tool free. All tools for $3/month.

## Your mail app

Keep the client you use

 maskwire Your toolbox 

 Reply from the receiving alias Rewrite sender addresses Redact matching text Archive instead of delete 

Example tools. You choose what runs.

## Your email provider

Your mailbox stays here

Connected over IMAP and SMTP. Tools run as mail passes through.

## No bullshit, tell me what Maskwire does.

You point your mail app at Maskwire. Maskwire connects to your upstream email server and applies the tools you enable as messages and commands pass through. Your mailbox stays with your provider.

Your upstream login details are encrypted with your public key. The private key is locked with your Maskwire password. When your mail app logs into an IMAP or SMTP session, that password unlocks the credentials so Maskwire can connect on your behalf. Stored credentials alone cannot unlock your mailbox.

Maskwire can process email during that session. This protects stored credentials; it is not end-to-end encryption of email content.

## Choose what your email does.

Enable the utilities you need. Each one has a specific job.

 01 Alias replies 02 Sender rewriting 03 Text redaction 04 Delete protection 05 Unsubscribe rewriting 06 Message age limits 

### Alias replies

Reply to mail sent to a configured alias. Maskwire rewrites the outgoing sender to that alias.

EXAMPLE Message received at`[email protected]` ↓ Maskwire applies your rule Reply sent from`[email protected]`

Applied after sending. See the guide for recipient and configuration requirements. Read the guide ↗

### Sender rewriting

Map a sending address to another address, with date patterns for addresses you want to rotate.

EXAMPLE Configured sender`[email protected]` ↓ Maskwire applies your rule Rewritten sender`[email protected]`

An illustrative date-based rule. Your upstream provider must allow the sending address. Read the guide ↗

### Text redaction

Define sensitive text patterns. Maskwire redacts matching content before the message is sent.

EXAMPLE Text matching your rule`Internal reference: PROJECT-42` ↓ Maskwire applies your rule Outgoing message`Internal reference: [redacted]`

Illustrative redaction. You configure the patterns; this does not automatically detect all sensitive information. 

### Delete protection

Redirect supported delete operations to an archive destination you configure.

EXAMPLE Client action`Move message to Trash` ↓ Maskwire applies your rule With your rule applied`Move message to Archive`

Configure the destination for your mailbox. This tool is not a backup. 

### Unsubscribe rewriting

Rewrite List-Unsubscribe mail links to preserve the sender context for your aliases.

### Message age limits

Limit the age of messages shown to your client, with rules for selected mailboxes.

EXAMPLE Mailbox contents`Recent and older messages` ↓ Maskwire applies your rule Client view with an age rule`Messages within your cutoff`

Older messages remain with your provider. 

## A new route to your existing mailbox.

Setup instructions ↗

01

### Connect your provider

Add your upstream IMAP and SMTP connection details to Maskwire.

### Choose your tools

Enable the utilities you want and configure their rules in your toolbox.

### Point your client here

Update your mail app's server settings to connect through Maskwire.

Check your setup first. You need a client with configurable IMAP/SMTP servers and a compatible upstream provider. Sender rewrites also depend on which addresses your provider allows.

Processing happens in transit. Maskwire processes mail during active connections. Read how credentials and sessions work before connecting your account. Explore the guides ↗

## Start free. Get the whole toolbox for $3.

Keep one tool free for as long as you need it.

Use the whole toolbox together.
